{"script":"set -e
ws=temp_var_count
mkdir -p "$ws"
# 2: capture context
{
  echo "user=$(id -un 2>/dev/null || id -u)"
  echo "group=$(id -gn 2>/dev/null || id -g)"
  echo "uid=$(id -u)"
  echo "gid=$(id -g)"
  echo "umask=$(umask)"
  echo "cwd=$(pwd)"
} > "$ws/context.txt"
# 3: raw listing of /var with file type and symlink target
find /var -printf "%p|%y|%l\n" 2> "$ws/find_errors.log" > "$ws/var_listing.raw"
# 4: resolve symlinks referenced in raw listing
rm -f "$ws/var_listing.resolved"
while IFS='|' read -r path type target; do
  if [ "$type" = "l" ]; then
    resolved=$(readlink -f -- "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$target")
  else
    resolved="$path"
  fi
  printf "%s|%s|%s\n" "$path" "$type" "$resolved"
done < "$ws/var_listing.raw" > "$ws/var_listing.resolved"
# 5: filter to regular files (resolved paths)
awk -F'|' '$2=="f" {print $3}' "$ws/var_listing.resolved" > "$ws/regular_files.list"
# 6: collect inode, size, mtime for each regular file
rm -f "$ws/file_metadata.tsv"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then
    stat -c "%i\t%s\t%Y\t%n" -- "$f" >> "$ws/file_metadata.tsv" || :
  fi
done < "$ws/regular_files.list"
# 7: group entries that share same inode (hard links)
rm -f "$ws/duplicates.tsv"
awk -F'\t' '{inode=$1; size=$2; mtime=$3; path=$4; cnt[inode]++; if (paths[inode]) paths[inode]=paths[inode]";"path; else paths[inode]=path; sizes[inode]=size; mtimes[inode]=mtime} END{print "inode\tcount\tsize\tmtime\tpaths\ttreat_as_single" > "'"$ws"'/duplicates.tsv"; for (i in cnt) { treat=(cnt[i]>1)?"yes":"no"; print i"\t"cnt[i]"\t"sizes[i]"\t"mtimes[i]"\t"paths[i]"\t"treat >> "'"$ws"'/duplicates.tsv" }}' "$ws/file_metadata.tsv"
# 8: independent second recursive listing and diff
find /var -printf "%p|%y|%l\n" 2> "$ws/find_errors.alt.log" > "$ws/var_listing.alt"
diff -u "$ws/var_listing.raw" "$ws/var_listing.alt" > "$ws/consistency_diff.txt" || true
# 9: create summary_prep.txt with counts and cross-checks
total_raw=$(wc -l < "$ws/var_listing.raw" || echo 0)
total_regular=$(wc -l < "$ws/regular_files.list" || echo 0)
total_unique_inodes=$(awk -F"\t" '{print $1}' "$ws/file_metadata.tsv" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l || echo 0)
discrepancies=$(wc -l < "$ws/consistency_diff.txt" || echo 0)
meta_lines=$(wc -l < "$ws/file_metadata.tsv" || echo 0)
dup_sum=$(awk -F"\t" 'NR>1{sum+= $2}END{print sum+0}' "$ws/duplicates.tsv" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
{
  echo "total_raw_entries=$total_raw"
  echo "total_regular_files=$total_regular"
  echo "total_unique_inodes=$total_unique_inodes"
  echo "consistency_diff_lines=$discrepancies"
  echo "file_metadata_lines=$meta_lines"
  echo "duplicates_total_paths=$dup_sum"
  if [ "$meta_lines" -eq "$total_regular" ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "meta_vs_regular=OK"; else echo "meta_vs_regular=Mismatch"; fi
  if [ "$dup_sum" -eq "$total_regular" ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "dup_sum_vs_regular=OK"; else echo "dup_sum_vs_regular=Mismatch"; fi
} > "$ws/summary_prep.txt"
# 10: record checksums for artifacts in workspace
rm -f "$ws/artifact_checksums.txt"
( find "$ws" -type f ! -name "artifact_checksums.txt" -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum ) > "$ws/artifact_checksums.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
# Print final total regular files (the requested total)
printf "%s" "$total_regular"
"}
